chatgptPrompt: Create a YouTube Shorts cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Subject: a soap bubble about as wide as an egg with a round hole opening in its film, iridescent thin-film colours around the rim, dark kitchen cabinet behind. Composition: bubble large centre, hole at upper right, dark kitchen cabinet behind for contrast. Lighting and treatment: backlit, thin-film colours; palette cream #E9E3D3, ink #1B1E24, cobalt #2F5BFF; shallow depth of field, clean exact surfaces. Mood: wonder. Text: "ELEVEN SECONDS" in a bold geometric sans, placed upper third. Scientific accuracy: the hole in a bursting bubble opens at several meters per second; the whole egg-sized bubble is gone in about a hundredth of a second. Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news photo. Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art. Keep the focal point inside the centre safe area, clear of the bottom 25%.
